name: Akshika Tekriwal
quote: My child's speech improved significantly at Ananya child development center. The dedicated skilled therapists help set up a friendly environment working with the child to achieve the goals. The wholistic approach makes all the difference. Highly recommended!

name: Ankit Patel
quote: The Speech Therapy Centre has truly worked magically for my kid's therapy. Their communication skill program has made remarkable improvement. Speech is a part of overall development and therapists focus on that holistically. Very grateful to the entire team.

name: Pulok Dhar
quote: The combo of Occupational Therapy and Speech Therapy is paying off beautifully. Big improvements in my child's abilities. Each session is well-tailored and super effective. Best therapy centre in Nallagandla.

name: Prashant Prajapati
quote: Autism Therapy at Ananya is a combination of three integrated therapies. Their approach helps children in every aspect—communication, behavior, and daily tasks. The interconnected therapy model is truly transformative for our family.

name: Kavya Arunachalam
quote: Ananya has helped my child tremendously. We've seen so much improvement within five months. The team is caring, patient, and answers all our queries. Eye contact improved significantly and most symptoms have resolved. Grateful beyond words.

name: Ahiron Handique
quote: Therapy at Ananya has transformed my son profoundly. The positive change in his behaviour is remarkable. The team is incredibly supportive, providing regular updates and thoughtful guidance throughout the journey.
